workflow_runs.name: i18n health
workflow_runs.display_title: clients/js: preserve nested API rejection errors

head_commit.message:
clients/js: preserve nested API rejection errors

Accept recursive error maps with string-array leaves in async responses.
The server forwards custom error maps through recursive localization,
so valid nested rejections must retain their API error kind and receipt.

Keep malformed leaves and metadata as protocol failures. Preserve flat
local validation errors and the callback envelope's default error type.
Expose the recursive wire shape through the async declarations.

workflow_runs.display_title: clients/js: expose the callback client as CallbackClient

head_commit.message:
clients/js: expose the callback client as CallbackClient

Export CallbackClient as the existing Client constructor so
applications can name callback and Promise clients explicitly. Keep
Client supported with the same identity, name, prototype, statics and
callback behavior.

Document the explicit names and check runtime loader identity and
emitted TypeScript value and instance aliases.
